statements.amount_as_heard: 22 million eight hundred and eighty three thousand four hundred and forty two dollars
statements.statement: The business manager stated the recommended FY24 school budget is a 2.5 percent increase over FY23, local funds only including Chapter 70.
Chapter 70 funding rose about 0.6 percent and the state funds 38.32 percent of the local budget.
Health insurance came in at 6.2 percent against an earlier budgeted 8 percent, a savings.
The vote to approve the FY24 school budget was delayed to March 22 after the public hearing.

warnings.prediction: The Turkey Hill building needs more significant remodeling; the town should not expect the same low-cost fix as the primary AC project.
